abstract: Governments use preferential trade agreements (PTAs), the WTO Trade Facilitation Agreement (TFA) and mutual recognition arrangements (MRAs) to reduce bilateral trade costs. Using data for 2010-2022 and a structural gravity framework, we assess the trade impact of a country-pair using all three policy instruments simultaneously. Our analysis considers MRAs for Authorized Economic Operator (AEO) programs that expedite customs clearance for certified actors in the supply chain. These are not product-specific, permitting comparative analysis of the trade impacts of the three types of international agreements. We find significant sectoral heterogeneity across the three instruments. The TFA has large effects on bilateral trade in non-food manufacturing products, while MRAs do more to boost the value of trade in agricultural and food-related products. Overall, international cooperation to reduce the costs of regulatory heterogeneity increases bilateral trade more than PTAs.
abstract_zh: 各国政府通过优惠贸易协定（PTAs）、世界贸易组织《贸易便利化协定》（TFA）以及相互承认安排（MRAs）来降低双边贸易成本。利用2010年至2022年的数据及结构性引力模型框架，我们评估了一对国家同时采用这三种政策工具对贸易的影响。我们的分析聚焦于授权经济经营者（AEO）项目的MRAs，这些项目旨在加速供应链中经认证参与者的海关清关流程。这些措施并非针对特定产品，从而允许对三类国际协定的贸易影响进行比较分析。我们发现，这三种工具在不同行业间存在显著的异质性。TFA对非食品制造业产品的双边贸易影响显著，而MRAs则更有利于提升农产品及食品相关产品的贸易额。总体而言，旨在减少监管差异成本的国际合作对双边贸易的促进作用超过了PTAs。
title: Trade agreements, trade facilitation and mutual recognition arrangements
title_zh: 贸易协定、贸易便利化与互认安排

abstract: We study the role of job‐to‐job transitions in shaping wage dynamics in the UK. We show that job moves have continued to generate substantial wage gains for movers even during a period of real wage stagnation and declining labour market mobility. Using an econometric model that accounts for worker, firm and match heterogeneity, we decompose the job mobility premium, and find a limited role for worker and firm effects, with most of the return explained by match‐specific factors. We also examine the determinants of job mobility, and show that much of its recent decline reflects compositional changes in the workforce, particularly ageing and increasing occupational professionalization. We conclude by discussing the policy challenges of promoting job mobility as a driver of wage growth and more efficient labour market reallocation.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了英国工作转换在塑造工资动态中的作用。我们表明，即使在实际工资停滞和劳动力市场流动性下降的时期，工作变动仍持续为流动者带来可观的工资收益。通过一个考虑工人、企业和匹配异质性的计量经济学模型，我们分解了工作流动溢价，发现工人和企业效应作用有限，大部分回报归因于匹配特定因素。我们还考察了工作流动的决定因素，并显示其近期下降很大程度上反映了劳动力构成的变化，特别是老龄化及职业专业化程度的提高。最后，我们讨论了促进工作流动作为工资增长和更有效劳动力市场再配置驱动力的政策挑战。
title:
Changing jobs: worker mobility and wages in the
                    UK
                    labour market
title_zh: 换工作：英国劳动力市场中的工人流动性与工资

abstract: Institutions facilitate short-selling by lending from their holdings, but what they hold is endogenous. This paper examines how institutional demand, driven by investment mandates (benchmarking), affects short-selling. In a model where benchmarked managers lend from their holdings, both lending supply and equilibrium price are higher for the benchmark asset, and so is shorting demand (due to inflated price). A quasi-experiment using Russell index reconstitution shows that stocks with more benchmarked capital have greater lending supply and demand. Ultimately, such stocks are costlier to short. In theory and data, results are driven by incomplete pass-through from benchmarked capital to lending supply.
abstract_zh: 机构通过出借其持有的证券来促进卖空，但其持有量是内生的。本文考察了由投资授权（基准化）驱动的机构需求如何影响卖空行为。在一个基准化管理者出借其持有资产的模型中，基准资产的借贷供给和均衡价格均更高，卖空需求也随之增加（因价格被抬高）。利用罗素指数重构进行的准实验表明，基准化资本占比更高的股票具有更大的借贷供给和需求。最终，这类股票的卖空成本更高。在理论和数据中，这些结果均由基准化资本向借贷供给的不完全传导所驱动。
title: Institutional investor mandates, securities lending, and short-selling constraints
title_zh: 机构投资者委托、证券借贷与卖空约束

abstract: Simple theoretical models of job search can imply that a higher minimum wage increases the number of job seekers for affected jobs. Researchers often appeal to these models in defending or explaining non-negative estimated employment effects of minimum wages. We use novel data on job search in U.S. states to examine the effect of minimum wage increases on the number of job seekers for low-skilled positions. We find little if any evidence that higher minimum wages increase job search for low-skilled jobs, and more evidence that higher minimum wages decrease the number of workers seeking employment in these jobs.
abstract_zh: 简单的求职理论模型可能暗示，最低工资提高会增加受影响职位的求职者数量。研究者常引用这些模型来为最低工资的非负就业效应估计进行辩护或解释。我们利用美国各州关于求职的新数据，考察最低工资上调对低技能岗位求职者数量的影响。我们发现，几乎没有证据表明更高的最低工资会增加低技能工作的求职活动，反而有更多证据显示，更高的最低工资会减少寻求这些岗位就业的工人数量。
title: Minimum wage laws and job search
title_zh: 最低工资法与求职行为

abstract: Social media influencers account for a growing share of marketing worldwide. We demonstrate the existence of a novel form of market failure in the advertising market: influencer cartels, where groups of influencers collude to increase their advertising revenue by inflating their engagement. Our theoretical model shows that influencer cartels can improve consumer welfare if they expand social media engagement to the target audience, or reduce welfare if they divert engagement to less relevant audiences. Drawing on the model’s insights, we empirically examine influencer cartels using novel datasets and machine learning tools, and derive policy implications.
abstract_zh: 社交媒体影响者在全球营销中的占比日益增长。我们揭示了广告市场中一种新型市场失灵现象：影响者卡特尔，即影响者群体串通一气，通过夸大其互动量来增加广告收入。我们的理论模型表明，若影响者卡特尔能将社交媒体互动扩展至目标受众，则可提升消费者福利；反之，若将互动转移至相关性较低的受众，则可能降低福利。基于模型洞见，我们运用新颖数据集和机器学习工具对影响者卡特尔进行实证研究，并得出政策启示。
journal: Journal of the European Economic Association
title: Influencer Cartels
title_zh: 网红卡特尔

abstract: Understanding the spatial distribution of air pollutants is essential for supporting air-quality management and land-use planning. This study developed an exploratory XGBoost–GAN framework to reconstruct annual PM 2.5 and NO 2 surfaces and to examine model-indicated pollutant-pattern differences under land-use scenarios in the Sichuan Basin, China. Annual observations from 113 monitoring stations during 2014–2024 were combined with multi-source auxiliary rasters, including aerosol optical depth, meteorological variables, land-use/land-cover data, nighttime light, elevation, and population density. Random Forest, Long Short-Term Memory, and XGBoost models were trained using 2014–2023 data and independently evaluated using 2024 station observations. XGBoost achieved the best overall performance, with R² values of 0.71 and 0.81 for PM 2.5 and NO 2 , respectively, and was therefore used to generate 1-km baseline pollutant surfaces for 2024. Two Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) models were then trained to translate land-use images into XGBoost-estimated pollutant maps, enabling scenario experiments involving plant, built-up land, and water-body configurations. Under the condition of exploratory mode response rather than causal analysis, the scenario analysis results indicate that multiple land use layouts are related to the local decrease in pollutant concentrations estimated by the model. This study provides a data-driven approach for joint pollutant mapping and preliminary screening of land-use planning scenarios, while highlighting the need for validation with observed land-use transitions in future work.
abstract_zh: 理解空气污染物的空间分布对于支持空气质量管理和土地利用规划至关重要。本研究开发了一种探索性的XGBoost–GAN框架，用于重建中国四川盆地年度PM2.5和NO2浓度表面，并检验在土地利用情景下模型指示的污染物格局差异。研究结合了2014—2024年间113个监测站的年度观测数据与多源辅助栅格数据，包括气溶胶光学厚度、气象变量、土地利用/覆盖数据、夜间灯光、高程和人口密度。利用2014—2023年数据训练了随机森林、长短期记忆网络和XGBoost模型，并使用2024年站点观测数据进行独立评估。XGBoost取得了最佳整体性能，PM2.5和NO2的R²值分别为0.71和0.81，因此被用于生成2024年1公里分辨率的基线污染物浓度表面。随后训练了两个生成对抗网络（GAN）模型，将土地利用图像转换为XGBoost估算的污染物地图，从而支持涉及植被、建设用地和水体配置的情景实验。在探索性模式响应而非因果分析的前提下，情景分析结果表明，多种土地利用布局与模型估算的局部污染物浓度下降相关。本研究提供了一种数据驱动的方法，用于联合污染物制图和土地利用规划情景的初步筛选，同时强调未来工作中需利用观测到的土地利用变化进行验证。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象明确为四川盆地，属于中国地区，且数据来自中国监测站，制度背景和核心应用均与中国直接相关。
title: An XGBoost-GAN framework for mapping PM2.5 and NO2 and exploring land-use scenarios in the Sichuan Basin
title_zh: 基于XGBoost-GAN框架的四川盆地PM2.5与NO2制图及土地利用情景探索

abstract: Agricultural and food policy is increasingly shaped by geopolitical instability, ecological constraints, technological disruption, political polarisation and declining trust in expertise. At the same time, calls for food system transformation have gained prominence as evidence accumulates on the environmental, health and social shortcomings of current food systems. Yet reform has frequently stalled despite extensive scientific analysis and broad recognition of the need for change. This paper examines why. After reviewing some traditional explanations for policy persistence, the paper introduces the concept of policy ontologies: underlying ways of understanding what the food system is, how it functions, what it is ultimately for and how change occurs. Three ideal‐type ontologies are identified: a productivity ontology, a power‐focused ontology and an ecological ontology. These ontologies shape the definition of policy problems and the selection of preferred policy responses, helping to explain why stakeholders often appear to talk past one another. As the Society begins its second century in a more turbulent and contested policy environment, the profession's central role remains the production of rigorous evidence. That contribution will be strengthened by a greater awareness of the different ways in which food systems are understood and of how these perspectives shape both policy debates and the interpretation of evidence. Recognising these underlying assumptions can help agricultural economists contribute more effectively to policy debate as honest brokers of policy alternatives.
abstract_zh: 农业与食品政策日益受到地缘政治不稳定、生态约束、技术颠覆、政治极化以及对专业知识信任度下降的影响。与此同时，随着关于当前食品体系在环境、健康和社会方面缺陷的证据不断积累，要求食品体系转型的呼声日益高涨。然而，尽管有广泛的科学分析和变革必要性的普遍共识，改革却常常陷入停滞。本文探讨了其中的原因。在回顾了关于政策持续性的传统解释之后，本文引入了政策本体论的概念：即对食品体系是什么、如何运作、其最终目的以及变革如何发生的基本理解方式。本文识别出三种理想类型的本体论：生产力本体论、权力聚焦本体论和生态本体论。这些本体论塑造了政策问题的定义和首选政策响应的选择，有助于解释为何利益相关者常常看似在自说自话。随着学会在一个更加动荡和充满争议的政策环境中开启其第二个世纪，本专业的核心角色仍然是提供严谨的证据。通过增强对食品体系不同理解方式以及这些视角如何影响政策辩论和证据解读的认识，这一贡献将得到加强。认识到这些潜在的假设，有助于农业经济学家作为政策替代方案的诚实中间人，更有效地为政策辩论做出贡献。
title: Agri‐Food Policymaking in More Turbulent Times: Reflections at the Centenary of the Agricultural Economics Society
title_zh: 动荡时期中的农业食品政策制定：农业经济学学会百年反思

abstract: I study redistribution between inactive, unemployed, and employed agents who are heterogeneous in their preferences and their productive skills in the labor market and at home. The government considers that redistribution across skills is desirable, but redistribution across preferences is not: if everyone has the same preferences, equality is optimal, but if everyone has the same skills, laissez-faire is optimal. In turn, this leads to a simple sufficient statistic to assess any reform: any extra dollar of transfer should go to the agent whose consumption is the furthest below what she would have consumed if everyone had average skills. In high-income countries, the gap between the lowest consumption and the average production is empirically much larger in the labor market than among inactives. Hence, introducing an inactivity benefit, or basic income, would neither be welfare-improving nor optimal for that social welfare function, regardless of labor supply elasticities.
abstract_zh: 我研究的是在劳动力市场与家庭中，偏好和生产技能均存在异质性的非活跃、失业及就业个体之间的再分配问题。政府认为，跨技能再分配是可取的，但跨偏好再分配则不然：若所有人偏好相同，则平等为最优；若所有人技能相同，则自由放任为最优。由此，这引出了一个简单的充分统计量来评估任何改革：每一额外转移支付的美元应流向消费水平最低于其若拥有平均技能时所应消费水平的个体。在高收入国家中，最低消费与平均产出之间的差距在劳动力市场中实证上远大于非活跃群体。因此，引入非活跃津贴或基本收入，无论劳动供给弹性如何，既不会改善福利，也不符合该社会福利函数下的最优状态。
title: Basic income versus fairness: redistribution with inactive agents
title_zh: 基本收入与公平：非活跃主体下的再分配

abstract: Under simple majority voting an absolute majority of voters may choose policies that are harmful to minorities. It is the purpose of sub- and supermajority rules to protect legitimate minority interests. We study how voting rules are chosen under the veil of ignorance and whether there are systematic biases in these choices. In our experiment, individuals choose voting rules for given distributions of gains and losses that can arise from a policy, but before learning their own valuation of the policy. We find that subjects on average adjust the voting rule in line with the skewness of the distribution. As a result, a higher share of the achievable surplus can be extracted with the suggested rules than with exogenously given simple majority voting. While the rule choices are not significantly biased towards under- or overprotection of the minority, towards majority voting or towards status-quo preserving rules, they only imperfectly reflect the distributions of benefits and costs. In expectation this leads to only 63% of the surplus being extracted. The participants are heterogeneous with respect to how well their rule choices adapt to the distribution of valuations, with a large share of the surplus loss caused by a small group of participants.
abstract_zh: 在简单多数投票制下，绝对多数的选民可能选择对少数群体有害的政策。设立少数和绝对多数规则的目的在于保护合法的少数群体利益。我们研究在无知之幕下投票规则如何被选择，以及这些选择中是否存在系统性偏差。在我们的实验中，个体在得知政策可能带来的收益与损失分布后，但在了解自身对政策估值之前，选择投票规则。我们发现，受试者平均会根据分布的偏度调整投票规则。因此，与外部给定的简单多数投票相比，所建议的规则能够提取更高比例的可行剩余。尽管规则选择并未显著偏向于对少数群体的过度或不足保护，也未偏向于多数投票或维持现状的规则，但它们仅不完美地反映了收益与成本的分布。预期而言，这导致仅提取了63%的剩余。参与者在规则选择适应估值分布的程度方面存在异质性，其中大部分剩余损失由一小部分参与者造成。
title: Minority Protection in Voting Mechanisms – Experimental Evidence
title_zh: 投票机制中的少数群体保护——实验证据

abstract: The attention on multi-product firms has focused primarily on firms’ product scope, i.e., how many products firms sell, rather than on which products they co-produce and sell. We address this by developing a stochastic heterogeneous-firm model that allows for correlations in production efficiencies across products and in consumers’ tastes across products and destinations. Our estimation strategy centers on a novel extension of generalized score matching. We use Chinese export data for the leather sector. The estimates reveal a clustered co-exportation structure consistent with correlated efficiency shocks across products sharing similar production processes.
abstract_zh: 关于多产品企业的研究，主要聚焦于企业的产品范围，即企业销售多少种产品，而非它们共同生产和销售哪些产品。我们通过构建一个随机异质性企业模型来解决这一问题，该模型允许不同产品间的生产效率以及不同产品和目的地间的消费者偏好存在相关性。我们的估计策略围绕广义得分匹配的一种新颖扩展展开。我们利用中国皮革行业的出口数据。估计结果显示，存在一种聚类共出口结构，这与共享相似生产流程的产品间效率冲击的相关性相一致。
china_relevance_reason: 研究使用中国皮革行业出口数据进行实证分析，中国数据是核心研究材料，因此与中国研究直接相关。
title: Co-exportation of products by multi-product firms
title_zh: 多产品企业的产品协同出口

abstract: PV (photovoltaic) farms are rapidly expanding across China, affecting its land use patterns and terrestrial ecosystems. While previous studies have shown that the effects of PV farms on vegetation are diverse, regulated by land cover, climate, and technology type, the role of human interventions, especially water management, in influencing vegetation dynamics remain insufficiently examined, leaving a critical knowledge gap. To bridge this gap, we assessed the vegetation dynamics of China’s PV farms using the normalized difference vegetation index, estimated human-induced evapotranspiration change ( ET h ) as a measure of water management intensity, and used machine learning models to assess its impact on vegetation dynamics. Our results showed that water management plays a critical role in driving vegetation recovery, with optimal ET h forming a climate-dependent ‘ridge pattern’ that increased from 92 mm/year in humid regions to 200 mm/year in arid zones. Optimized water management can increase the improvement in vegetation greenness to 2.3 times that under observed scenario, while reducing total water consumption by 21.5%. Importantly, our findings provide evidence-based guidance for region-specific water management policies aiming to promote ecological restoration in PV farms while also supporting sustainable land use practices.
abstract_zh: 光伏（PV）电站正在中国迅速扩张，深刻影响其土地利用格局与陆地生态系统。尽管已有研究表明，光伏电站对植被的影响因土地覆盖、气候和技术类型而异，呈现多样性，但人为干预，尤其是水资源管理，在影响植被动态中的作用仍未得到充分探讨，留下了关键的知识空白。为填补这一空白，我们利用归一化差异植被指数评估了中国光伏电站的植被动态，估算人为引起的蒸散发变化（ET h ）作为水资源管理强度的度量，并采用机器学习模型评估其对植被动态的影响。结果表明，水资源管理在驱动植被恢复中发挥关键作用，最优ET h 形成一种依赖气候的“脊状模式”，从湿润地区的92毫米/年递增至干旱区的200毫米/年。优化水资源管理可将植被绿度改善程度提升至观测情景下的2.3倍，同时减少总用水量21.5%。重要的是，我们的发现为旨在促进光伏电站生态恢复并支持可持续土地利用实践的区域特定水资源管理政策提供了基于证据的指导。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Water management regulates vegetation recovery in photovoltaic farms across China
title_zh: 中国光伏电站水资源管理调控植被恢复研究

abstract: Multiple land rights holders and layered land rights structures create fundamental challenges for implementing land-based financing methods such as land value capture (LVC). In a decentralized governance system, overlapping land rights and fragmented planning complicate coordination and limit the effectiveness of LVC for financing transport infrastructure development. This study examines how different rights holders contribute to implementing land value capture within a layered land rights and multi-level governance system in Indonesia, using the Jakarta Mass Rapid Transit (MRT) project as a case study. In Indonesia’s decentralized system, multiple levels of government apply different planning tools to regulate land use and development, complicating coordination between planning, land rights, and LVC mechanisms. Qualitative data from semi-structured interviews and policy analysis show that overlapping land rights and fragmented regulations create legal and administrative uncertainty. This uncertainty acts as a barrier to cross-governmental coordination and private stakeholder engagement, both of which are necessary for a workable LVC framework. Although a formal LVC framework exists, unclear rules on which rights holders should contribute, combined with complex administrative procedures, limit its practical use. This study contributes to the LVC literature by linking instruments to specific land rights holders and by extending the bundle-of-rights perspective. It explains why LVC remains underutilized in contexts with layered land rights and decentralized governance. The findings highlight the need for policy reforms to clarify contribution obligations, improve coordination across governance levels, and simplify the administrative process.
abstract_zh: 多重土地权利主体与分层土地权利结构，为实施土地价值捕获（LVC）等土地融资方式带来了根本性挑战。在分散化治理体系下，土地权利重叠与规划碎片化使协调工作复杂化，并限制了LVC在交通基础设施发展融资中的有效性。本研究以雅加达大众快速交通（MRT）项目为案例，考察在印度尼西亚分层土地权利与多层治理体系中，不同权利主体如何参与土地价值捕获的实施。在印度尼西亚的分散化体制下，多级政府运用不同的规划工具来规范土地利用与开发，这使得规划、土地权利与LVC机制之间的协调更加复杂。基于半结构化访谈与政策分析的定性数据表明，土地权利重叠与法规碎片化造成了法律和行政层面的不确定性。这种不确定性成为跨政府协调与私营利益相关方参与的障碍，而这两者均为可行的LVC框架所必需。尽管存在正式的LVC框架，但关于哪些权利主体应承担贡献义务的规则不明确，加之复杂的行政程序，限制了其实际应用。本研究通过将工具与特定土地权利主体相联系，并拓展权利束视角，为LVC文献作出贡献。研究解释了为何在分层土地权利与分散化治理背景下，LVC仍未被充分利用。研究结果凸显了政策改革的必要性，以明确贡献义务、改善跨治理层级的协调，并简化行政程序。
title: Layered land rights under government-led decentralization: Implications for land value capture implementation in Jakarta, Indonesia
title_zh: 政府主导分权下的分层土地权利：对印度尼西亚雅加达土地价值捕获实施的影响

abstract: This paper proposes a novel time-varying model averaging (TVMA) approach to enhancing forecast accuracy for multivariate time series subject to structural changes. The TVMA method averages predictions from a set of time-varying vector autoregressive models using optimal time-varying combination weights selected by minimizing a penalized local criterion. This allows the relative importance of different models to adaptively evolve over time in response to structural shifts. We establish an asymptotic optimality for the proposed TVMA approach in achieving the lowest possible quadratic forecast errors. The convergence rate of the selected time-varying weights to the optimal weights minimizing expected quadratic errors is derived. Moreover, we show that when one or more correctly specified models exist, our method consistently assigns full weight to them, and an asymptotic normality for the TVMA estimators under some regularity conditions can be established. Furthermore, the proposed approach encompasses special cases including time-varying VAR models with exogenous predictors, as well as time-varying factor augmented VAR (FAVAR) models. Simulations and empirical applications illustrate the proposed TVMA method outperforms some commonly used model averaging and selection methods in the presence of structural changes.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种新颖的时变模型平均（TVMA）方法，旨在提升面临结构变化的多变量时间序列预测准确性。TVMA方法通过最小化惩罚局部准则选取最优时变组合权重，对一组时变向量自回归模型的预测结果进行平均。这使得不同模型的相对重要性能够随时间自适应调整，以应对结构转变。我们为所提出的TVMA方法建立了渐近最优性，确保其达到最低可能的二次预测误差。同时，推导了所选时变权重向最小化期望二次误差的最优权重收敛的速度。此外，我们证明，在存在一个或多个正确设定模型的情况下，该方法能一致地将全部权重赋予这些模型，并在一定正则条件下，可建立TVMA估计量的渐近正态性。进一步地，所提方法涵盖了特殊情形，包括含外生预测变量的时变VAR模型，以及时变因子增强VAR（FAVAR）模型。模拟与实证应用表明，在结构变化存在时，所提出的TVMA方法优于一些常用的模型平均与选择方法。
title: Model averaging for time–varying vector autoregressions
title_zh: 时变向量自回归的模型平均

abstract: We evaluate the impact of the disclosure of artificial intelligence (AI) involvement in a charitable fundraising experiment, where participants received either AI‐generated or human‐written fundraising letters, with or without the disclosure of their origin. We find that both AI‐generated letters (whether edited by humans or not) and human‐written letters (whether edited by AI or not) significantly increase donations, producing similar positive effects. Importantly, these effects disappear when AI involvement is disclosed, regardless of whether the letters are generated or edited by AI. These findings suggest that, while AI improves the effectiveness of charitable fundraising, disclosing its use offsets this benefit.
abstract_zh: 我们评估了在慈善募捐实验中披露人工智能（AI）参与的影响，该实验中，参与者收到了由AI生成或人类撰写的募捐信函，并可能被告知其来源。我们发现，无论是AI生成的信函（无论是否经过人工编辑）还是人类撰写的信函（无论是否经过AI编辑），都能显著增加捐款，且产生相似的正向效果。重要的是，当披露AI参与时，这些效果消失，无论信函是由AI生成还是编辑。这些发现表明，尽管AI提升了慈善募捐的有效性，但披露其使用却抵消了这一益处。
title: AI helps until you say it does
title_zh: AI助益，直至你言明其止

abstract: Contrary to a long-standing concern, we present evidence that classical benefit-based labor income taxation in the tradition of Smith (1776) is consistent with income redistribution through transfers and negative average tax rates both theoretically and—in plausibly-specified simulations—quantitatively, at levels which reflect U.S. policy over the past several decades. As redistribution is widespread in practice, our results remove an obstacle to the benefit principle’s plausibility as a prevailing normative foundation of tax policy.
abstract_zh: 与长期以来的担忧相反，我们提供的证据表明，遵循斯密（1776）传统的基于福利的古典劳动所得税制，在理论上与通过转移支付和负平均税率实现的收入再分配相一致，并且在合理设定的模拟中，其量化水平也反映了美国过去几十年的政策实践。鉴于再分配在实践中普遍存在，我们的研究结果消除了福利原则作为税收政策主流规范基础所面临的一个障碍。
title: Benefit-based taxation can include substantial redistribution
title_zh: 基于受益的税收可包含显著的再分配效应

abstract: Understanding the determinants of illegal rhino horn prices can provide information for the design of policies to conserve wild rhinoceroses. Using a theoretical model, we identify empirical measures that may affect illegal rhino horn prices and derive testable hypotheses about their expected effects. We test these hypotheses using time series data on actual illegal market prices of rhino horn in Vietnam. The price data were collected from consumers who purchased rhino horn in Vietnam between 2001 and 2020. Assuming that the illegal rhino horn markets in China and Vietnam are perfectly integrated, we examine the effects of various regulatory measures implemented in both countries. We find that China's legalisation of trade in rhino horn antiques and the implementation of an anti‐corruption campaign are associated with significant reductions in illegal rhino horn price in Vietnam, whereas Vietnam's increased sanctions on the rhino horn trade and use have no significant effects. These findings suggest that, in addition to wildlife‐specific policies, broader institutional reforms and governance crackdowns in China may substantially affect illegal rhino horn prices in Vietnam.
abstract_zh: 了解非法犀牛角价格的决定因素，可为制定保护野生犀牛的政策提供信息。通过理论模型，我们识别出可能影响非法犀牛角价格的实证指标，并推导出关于其预期影响的可检验假设。我们利用越南非法犀牛角实际市场价格的时间序列数据来检验这些假设。价格数据来源于2001年至2020年间在越南购买犀牛角的消费者。假设中国和越南的非法犀牛角市场完全一体化，我们考察了两国实施的各种监管措施的效果。研究发现，中国对犀牛角古董贸易的合法化以及反腐败运动的实施，与越南非法犀牛角价格显著下降相关联，而越南对犀牛角贸易和使用加强制裁则未产生显著影响。这些结果表明，除了针对野生动物的特定政策外，中国更广泛的制度性改革和治理整顿可能对越南非法犀牛角价格产生实质性影响。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
journal: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
title: The Price of a Horn: How Governance and Policy Shape an Illegal Wildlife Market
title_zh: 象牙之价：治理与政策如何塑造非法野生动物市场

abstract: This paper exploits a quasi-natural experiment provided by China’s Province-Managing-County (PMC) fiscal reform to examine the impact of fiscal decentralization on under-five mortality. Using a county-level panel dataset from 1999 to 2012 matched with county-level under-five mortality data, we employ a staggered DID design to identify the health effect of fiscal decentralization. The results show that the PMC fiscal reform significantly increased county-level under-five mortality, an increase of approximately 1.02–1.51 deaths per 1,000 live births. The reduction in the provision of public healthcare services and increases in air pollution are two potential channels through which the reform adversely affects under-five mortality. The adverse effect can be strengthened by fiscal pressures,legal transparency and political promotion incentives of local officials. KEYWORDS: Fiscal decentralization healthcare under-five mortality JEL CLASSIFICATION: H75 H77 I18
abstract_zh: 本文利用中国省直管县财政改革所提供的准自然实验，考察了财政分权对五岁以下儿童死亡率的影响。基于1999年至2012年的县级面板数据，并匹配县级五岁以下儿童死亡率数据，我们采用交错双重差分设计来识别财政分权的健康效应。研究结果显示，省直管县财政改革显著提高了县级五岁以下儿童死亡率，每千例活产婴儿中死亡人数增加约1.02至1.51人。公共卫生服务供给的减少以及空气污染的加剧，是改革对五岁以下儿童死亡率产生不利影响的两条潜在渠道。财政压力、法律透明度以及地方官员的政治晋升激励会强化这一不利影响。关键词：财政分权；医疗卫生；五岁以下儿童死亡率 JEL分类号：H75 H77 I18
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: The impact of fiscal decentralization on under-five mortality: evidence from China
title_zh: 财政分权对五岁以下儿童死亡率的影响：来自中国的证据

abstract: How do we evaluate the welfare gains from transport infrastructure investment? We present a quantitative spatial framework that integrates traffic and economic responses to infrastructure improvements and derives the elasticity of aggregate welfare to changes in the transportation network. The resulting formula extends the traditional "social savings'' method to incorporate route and mode choice, agglomeration and dispersion externalities, and traffic congestion. We apply the formula to the U.S. freight network and assess the benefits of reducing costs on each segment of the U.S. Interstate Highway System. The traditional and extended measures are closely related overall, but they differ in the level of estimated gains and in the ranking of some highly valued links. Where the rankings differ, network position determines how congestion and spatial adjustment alter a link's measured benefit.
abstract_zh: 我们如何评估交通基础设施投资的福利收益？我们提出一个定量空间框架，该框架整合了交通与基础设施改善的经济响应，并推导出总体福利对交通网络变化的弹性。由此得出的公式扩展了传统的“社会节约”方法，纳入了路线与模式选择、集聚与分散外部性以及交通拥堵因素。我们将此公式应用于美国货运网络，并评估了减少美国州际公路系统各路段成本所带来的收益。传统与扩展措施总体紧密相关，但在估计收益水平及某些高价值路段的排序上存在差异。在排序不同的地方，网络位置决定了拥堵和空间调整如何改变路段的测量收益。
title: From Social Savings to Spatial Equilibrium: Evaluating Transportation Improvements in Quantitative Spatial Models
title_zh: 从社会储蓄到空间均衡：量化空间模型中交通改善的评估

abstract: Climate change affects agriculture directly through crop yield losses and indirectly through changes in crop prices. Farmers need to adapt their land-use decisions to these changing conditions. These decisions are made in advance and under considerable uncertainty. The extent to which farmers adapt their crop area allocations to changing yields and prices remains unclear, particularly at the national scale. We present an approach for measuring the adaptedness of observed crop area allocations to changing yields and prices in terms of the number of hectares differing from an economically optimal cropping pattern. We demonstrate the approach in a case study in Germany (1999–2020). To identify economically optimal crop area allocations under changing yields and prices, we employ an econometric mathematical programming (EMP) approach within a multi-agent system modeling framework. Over the 20 years, we find persistent changes in crop area allocations averaging 36% ±4% of each district’s agricultural area. Of these changes, 43% improved the adaptedness to today’s yields and prices. We observe a trend of increasing adaptedness over time, though significantly lower in districts facing drought conditions. Adaptation, however, prevails both under drought and non-drought conditions. Our results suggest that the economic impacts of changing yields and prices play a significant role in shaping observed land-use patterns, with important implications for land-use dynamics under climate change. Our approach opens promising avenues for further research seeking to disentangle the drivers of land-use adaptation over time and to inform future policies aimed at supporting agricultural adaptation to increasing weather extremes and changing climatic conditions.
abstract_zh: 气候变化通过作物产量损失直接影响农业，并通过作物价格变化间接影响农业。农民需要根据这些变化条件调整其土地利用决策，而这些决策需提前做出，且面临相当大的不确定性。农民在多大程度上根据产量和价格的变化调整其作物面积分配，目前尚不清楚，尤其是在国家尺度上。我们提出了一种方法，用以衡量观测到的作物面积分配对产量和价格变化的适应程度，具体以偏离经济最优种植模式的公顷数来表示。我们在德国的一项案例研究（1999-2020年）中展示了该方法。为识别在产量和价格变化下的经济最优作物面积分配，我们在多智能体系统建模框架内采用了计量经济数学规划（EMP）方法。在这20年间，我们发现作物面积分配发生了持续变化，平均占每个地区农业面积的36%±4%。其中，43%的变化改善了对当前产量和价格的适应程度。我们观察到适应程度随时间呈上升趋势，但在面临干旱条件的地区，这一趋势显著较低。然而，无论在干旱还是非干旱条件下，适应现象均普遍存在。我们的结果表明，产量和价格变化的经济影响在塑造观测到的土地利用模式中发挥着重要作用，这对气候变化下的土地利用动态具有重要意义。我们的方法为进一步研究土地利用适应随时间变化的驱动因素，以及为制定支持农业适应日益加剧的极端天气和变化气候条件的未来政策，开辟了有前景的途径。
title: Measuring adaptation in action: Uncovering agricultural land-use responses to changing yields and prices
title_zh: 衡量适应行动：揭示农业土地利用对产量与价格变化的响应

abstract: The European objective of achieving “No Net Land Take” (NNLT) by 2050 represents an ambitious paradigm shift in the fields of urban planning and architecture. However, the primary obstacles to its implementation are not technical in nature, but rather stem from our society’s inability to reform itself in order to attain this fundamental goal. This viewpoint paper reviews the political, economic, and sociocultural barriers that must be overcome to effectively halt the loss of agricultural and natural land.
abstract_zh: 欧洲到2050年实现“零净土地占用”（NNLT）的目标，标志着城市规划和建筑领域的一次雄心勃勃的范式转变。然而，其实施的主要障碍并非技术层面，而是源于我们社会在实现这一根本目标上的自我改革能力不足。本文从观点角度审视了必须克服的政治、经济和社会文化障碍，以有效遏制农业和自然土地的流失。
title: The European No Net Land Take objective: A meta-challenge
title_zh: 欧洲净零土地占用目标：一项元挑战

abstract: The European Union’s increasing focus on voluntary approaches to the adoption of sustainability practices calls for a deeper understanding of farmers' decision-making and the behavioral mechanisms underlying the uptake. We conducted a best-worst scaling experiment among Italian winegrowers investigating the most and least relevant among 11 behavioral factors—encompassing dispositional, social, and cognitive dimensions—associated with the decision to adopt sustainable farming practices. Moreover, we also evaluated how contextual and farm structural characteristics relate to the relative importance attributed to each behavioral factor. Results indicate that expected environmental benefits and sensitivity to environmental issues are the most important factors, followed by expected economic benefits and expected costs, whereas social approval and the behavior of other farmers are the least important. The relative importance attributed to behavioral factors is significantly associated with farm size, farm type, and perception of barriers to adoption. The perception of economic barriers is significantly associated with a lower importance attributed to most factors. From a policy perspective, our findings suggest that providing information on the costs and benefits of sustainable farming practices should be prioritized; however, this alone is likely to be insufficient without accompanying economic support for adoption.
abstract_zh: 欧盟日益重视采用自愿性方法来推行可持续农业实践，这要求我们更深入地理解农户的决策过程及其背后的行为机制。我们针对意大利葡萄种植者开展了一项最优-最差标度实验，探究了与采纳可持续农业实践决策相关的11项行为因素（涵盖倾向性、社会及认知维度）中最重要和最不重要的因素。此外，我们还评估了情境和农场结构特征如何与各行为因素被赋予的相对重要性相关联。结果显示，预期的环境效益和对环境问题的敏感性是最重要的因素，其次是预期的经济效益和预期成本，而社会认可和其他农户的行为则最不重要。行为因素相对重要性的显著关联因素包括农场规模、农场类型以及对采纳障碍的感知。对经济障碍的感知与大多数因素被赋予的重要性较低显著相关。从政策角度来看，我们的研究结果表明，应优先提供关于可持续农业实践成本与效益的信息；然而，若无相应的经济支持，仅此一项可能不足以促进采纳。
title: Behavioral drivers of the adoption of sustainable agricultural practices: A best-worst scaling experiment among Italian winegrowers
title_zh: 可持续农业实践采纳的行为驱动因素：意大利葡萄种植者的最优最劣标度实验

abstract: While Brazil and Argentina emerged as major players in the world grain markets following a rapid expansion of corn and soybean production, little is known about their production forecasts. Our study demonstrates that the accuracy of USDA forecasts of Brazil and Argentina’s corn and soybean production varies drastically over the extended forecasting cycle. Specifically, early forecasts are not directionally consistent and offer limited statistical advantage to a naïve alternative. After 8–10 months into the forecasting cycle, these forecasts begin to provide meaningful information to market participants and become more accurate, efficient and reliable for the remainder of the forecasting cycle. These forecasts support export estimates in the US WASDE balance sheets as well as USDA baseline forecasts that have implications for federal budget outlays and may result in misallocation of resources when early projections are used.
abstract_zh: 尽管巴西和阿根廷在全球谷物市场中因玉米和大豆产量的迅速扩张而成为重要参与者，但对其生产预测的了解却十分有限。我们的研究表明，美国农业部对巴西和阿根廷玉米及大豆产量的预测准确性在延长预测周期内波动剧烈。具体而言，早期预测在方向上并不一致，并且相对于一个简单的替代方案，其统计优势有限。在预测周期进入8至10个月后，这些预测开始为市场参与者提供有意义的信息，并在预测周期的剩余时间内变得更加准确、高效和可靠。这些预测支持了美国农业部WASDE平衡表中的出口估算以及基线预测，后者对联邦预算支出有影响，且当使用早期预测时可能导致资源配置不当。
title: The new grain giants: the reliability of USDA’s corn and soybean production forecasts for Brazil and Argentina
title_zh: 新粮食巨头：美国农业部对巴西和阿根廷玉米及大豆产量预测的可靠性

abstract: This paper introduces the Comparative Travel Expenditure (CTE) method, a novel approach to derive exchange values for recreation-related ecosystem services (RES) compliant with the System of Environmental Economic Accounting - Ecosystem Accounting framework. Our approach builds upon the environmental economic literature by modifying the established travel-cost method in order to only consider market transactions to estimate the expenditures directly attributable to RES. By comparing the recreation demand of two sites with different ecosystem conditions, the CTE method allows us to estimate the difference in price driven by such differences in ecosystem conditions, thereby isolating the exchange value of RES for accounting purposes. To illustrate the CTE method, we conduct an empirical estimation of the RES exchange value of an Italian marine protected area, estimating that 66% of the travel expenditures incurred by tourists are driven by marine and coastal ecosystems, which significantly contribute to the local economy.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了一种新颖的“比较旅行支出”（CTE）方法，旨在推导符合《环境经济核算体系-生态系统核算》框架的休闲相关生态系统服务（RES）交换价值。该方法在环境经济学文献基础上，通过修改既有的旅行成本法，仅考虑市场交易来估算直接归因于RES的支出。通过比较两个生态系统条件不同的地点的休闲需求，CTE方法使我们能够估算由生态系统条件差异引起的价格差异，从而为核算目的分离出RES的交换价值。为说明CTE方法，我们对意大利一个海洋保护区的RES交换价值进行了实证估算，结果显示，游客旅行支出中有66%由海洋和沿海生态系统驱动，这些生态系统对当地经济贡献显著。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: The Comparative Travel Expenditure Method for Ecosystem Accounting
title_zh: 生态系统核算的比较旅行支出法

abstract: Access to space is now a national security priority, yet its cost varies enormously across nations. Using a novel dataset of over 6,740 rocket launches (1960–2025), we estimate country-level launch costs and country-specific experience curves. In 2025, the average costs per kilogram to Low Earth Orbit ranged from $3,225 in the United States to over $13,000 in India, with Europe, Russia, China, and Japan in between. Since 2010, only the US and Europe display statistically significant experience curves, with the US improving far faster. These widening asymmetries reinforce strategic dependencies with economic and security implications.
abstract_zh: 进入太空现已成为国家安全优先事项，然而各国在此方面的成本差异巨大。利用一项涵盖1960至2025年间超过6740次火箭发射的新数据集，我们估算了国家层面的发射成本及各国特有的经验曲线。2025年，将每公斤载荷送入近地轨道的平均成本，从美国的3225美元到印度的超过13000美元不等，欧洲、俄罗斯、中国和日本则介于两者之间。自2010年以来，仅美国和欧洲展现出统计上显著的经验曲线，其中美国的改进速度远快于他国。这些日益扩大的不对称性加剧了战略依赖，并带来经济与安全方面的深远影响。
china_relevance_reason: 论文研究全球航天发射成本与地缘政治，中国仅作为比较对象之一，非核心研究对象或数据主体。
title: Geopolitics and space access: cost asymmetries and strategic dependence
title_zh: 地缘政治与太空进入：成本不对称与战略依赖

abstract: Academic freedom has been declining over the past decade across the world. This column analyses over 25,000 economics working papers to show that, beyond direct intervention by authorities, political pressure also breeds self-censorship. After US federal agencies began screening research for a list of flagged words in early 2025, economists at universities most dependent on federal funding reduced politically sensitive content – even in research without any direct federal funding.
abstract_zh: 过去十年间，全球学术自由持续下滑。本专栏分析了超过25,000篇经济学工作论文，揭示出除当局直接干预外，政治压力亦催生自我审查。自2025年初美国联邦机构开始对研究进行敏感词汇筛查以来，最依赖联邦资助的大学经济学家，即便在未获任何直接联邦资金支持的研究中，也减少了政治敏感内容。
authors: Dominic Rohner, Oliver Vanden Eynde, Philine Widmer
title: When political pressure trumps academic freedom
title_zh: 当政治压力凌驾于学术自由之上

abstract: The rapid diffusion of generative AI has revived fears that a new wave of automation will inevitably shift income away from workers. This column uses data covering nearly the universe of French firms between 1994 and 2019 to test the relationship between automation and the labour share of income at the firm level. While firms clearly automated extensively over this period, the evidence shows that it can profoundly reshape jobs and production without necessarily shifting income from labour to capital.
abstract_zh: 生成式人工智能的迅速普及重新引发了人们的担忧，即新一轮自动化浪潮将不可避免地使收入从劳动者手中转移。本文利用1994年至2019年间覆盖几乎所有法国企业的数据，检验了自动化与企业层面劳动收入份额之间的关系。尽管在此期间企业确实广泛实施了自动化，但证据表明，自动化能够深刻重塑就业和生产，却未必会将收入从劳动转向资本。
authors: Zsofia Barany, Aseem Patel, Christian Siegel
title: Automation does not lower the labour share
title_zh: 自动化并未降低劳动份额

abstract: This paper provides new evidence on the nexus between railroads and inventive activities in Italy in the period 1861-1936. We develop two new georeferenced datasets on railway stations and patents. By adopting the staggered difference in differences identification strategy by Callaway and Sant’Anna (2021), we show that the impact of railroad construction on innovation is only visible for the first wave of construction of the period of the Destra storica (1861-1878), when the network was expanded following a state building strategy. However, these effects became noticeable only after more than two decades and concern mostly independent inventors and low-quality patents.
abstract_zh: 本文为1861-1936年间意大利铁路建设与发明活动之间的关联提供了新的证据。我们构建了两个新的地理参照数据集，分别涉及火车站和专利。采用Callaway和Sant’Anna（2021）提出的交错差分识别策略，我们表明铁路建设对创新的影响仅在“历史右翼”时期（1861-1878）的第一波建设浪潮中显现，当时铁路网络的扩展遵循了国家建设战略。然而，这些效应在二十多年后才变得显著，且主要涉及独立发明者和低质量专利。
title: Rails of Progress? Exploring the Nexus between Railroad Access and Innovation in Italy (19th-20th Centuries)
title_zh: 进步的轨道？铁路通达与意大利创新之间的关联探析（19至20世纪）

abstract: We review the “production approach” to estimating markups, the ratio of price to marginal cost. The approach is scalable. It requires no model of consumer demand or market structure and applies broadly across firms, industries, and time. We organize our review around a simple insight: the production-based markup is a residual. Like the Solow residual, it is clean in theory but potentially contaminated by misspecification and mismeasurement. This framing helps explain why small differences in implementation can produce starkly different results from the same data. In some cases, estimated markups have risen sharply. In others, they have not. We provide conceptual rationales for these disagreements, offer practical guidance on data and estimation, and call for greater transparency about how much of the variation attributed to markups may instead reflect technology.
abstract_zh: 我们回顾了估算加成率（价格与边际成本之比）的“生产法”。该方法具有可扩展性，无需消费者需求或市场结构模型，广泛适用于企业、行业及不同时期。我们的综述围绕一个简单洞见展开：基于生产的加成率是一种残差。如同索洛残差，它在理论上清晰，但可能受到设定错误和测量误差的污染。这一框架有助于解释为何实施中的细微差异能从相同数据中产生截然不同的结果。在某些情况下，估算的加成率显著上升；在其他情况下则不然。我们为这些分歧提供了概念上的解释，就数据与估算给出实用指导，并呼吁提高透明度，以明确归因于加成率的变动中有多少可能实际上反映了技术因素。
title: Micro and Macro Perspectives on Production-Based Markups
title_zh: 基于生产的加成定价：微观与宏观视角

abstract: This paper analyzes difference-in-differences designs with a continuous treatment. We show that treatment-on-the-treated-type parameters are identified under a parallel trends assumption analogous to the binary treatment case. However, comparing these parameters across treatments is challenging because parallel trends does not rule out selection bias. We discuss alternative, typically stronger, assumptions that eliminate selection bias. We further show that popular two-way fixed effects estimands admit multiple interpretations, depending on the underlying causal building block, all having important limitations as meaningful summaries of treatment effects. Finally, we introduce alternative estimation procedures that avoid these drawbacks and demonstrate them in an empirical application.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了连续处理下的双重差分设计。我们证明，在类似于二元处理情况的平行趋势假设下，处理组处理效应型参数是可识别的。然而，跨处理比较这些参数颇具挑战性，因为平行趋势并未排除选择偏差。我们讨论了通常更强、能消除选择偏差的替代假设。进一步，我们表明流行的双向固定效应估计量允许多种解释，这取决于潜在的因果构建模块，且所有这些解释作为处理效应的有意义汇总都存在重要局限。最后，我们引入了避免这些缺陷的替代估计程序，并在一个实证应用中加以展示。
title: Difference-in-Differences with a Continuous Treatment
title_zh: 连续处理下的双重差分法
